name: RECEIVED
description: RECEIVED returns the amount received at maturity for a discounted security, such as a Treasury bill, based on the investment amount and discount rate.
tldr: Calculates the amount received at maturity for a fully invested security.

basicExample.description: Maturity value of a discounted investment
basicExample.explanation: Investing $95,000 at a 5% discount rate for one year results in a $100,000 maturity value.

advancedExamples.title: With actual/360 basis
advancedExamples.explanation: Basis 2 is common for money market instruments.

howItWorks: RECEIVED calculates the maturity value by dividing the investment amount by (1 - discount * days to maturity / days per year). It is used for fully invested discount instruments.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Investment is the actual amount invested, not per $100.
Basis affects the day count and year length.

commonErrors.fix: Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: RECEIVED works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between RECEIVED and INTRATE?
faq.answer: RECEIVED calculates the maturity value from the investment and discount rate. INTRATE calculates the interest rate from the investment and maturity value.

faq.question: When is RECEIVED used?
faq.answer: It is used for Treasury bills and other fully invested discount instruments.
